title: pack_manifest
description: Manifest of a .qpack data pack (zip + manifest) built by tools/pack-builder (Handbook §6.3). Packs are immutable and signed; clients refuse unsigned or checksum-failing packs (NFR-1). CI fails if any licenses[].item is absent from schemas/licenses.json (§6.4).

manifest_version.description: Manifest format version; bump only via ADR.

version.description: CalVer YYYY.0M.MICRO; updates ship as new versions, clients keep current + previous.

contents.description: Dataset items included in the pack.

checksums.description: SHA-256 per contents item; keys must be a subset of contents (enforced by pack-builder, mirrored in golden tests R8).

license.description: SPDX identifier or registry-defined license code from schemas/licenses.json.

attribution.description: Attribution string rendered on the About screen.

licenses.description: Per-item license declarations; every item must exist in the licensing registry (§6.4).

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the canonical manifest bytes (signature field excluded).
